text:
### Case Closure  
**Investigation Complete When:**  
```
1. All evidence gathered and analyzed
2. Determination made (fraud/not fraud/inconclusive)
3. Customer refunded (if applicable)
4. Prevention actions implemented
5. Police report filed (if applicable)
6. Case documented
7. Manager approval obtained
```  
**Closure Notification to Customer:**  
```
Sample Letter:

Dear [Customer Name],

We have completed our investigation into the disputed transaction
of £[amount] on [date].

Finding: Unauthorized transaction (FRAUD CONFIRMED)

Action: Refund of £[amount] issued to your account on [date]

Please allow 1–2 business days for the refund to appear.

Prevention: We have:
- Issued new card (old one cancelled)
- Reset your online banking password
- Enabled extra security features
- Reported to police (reference: [number])

What You Should Do:
- Review your recent statements for other unauthorized transactions
- Update passwords on all important accounts (email, social media, etc.)
- Consider identity theft protection service
- Monitor your credit report

Questions? Contact us: 0800-555-2265

Best regards,
FirstUK Bank Financial Crime Team
```

raw_entities.name: Fraud Investigation Case Closure Process
raw_entities.description: End-to-end procedure for closing a fraud investigation case once all evidence has been gathered, a determination made, and appropriate remedial actions completed. Includes customer notification, refund issuance, prevention measures, and police reporting where applicable.
context: Investigation Complete When: All evidence gathered and analyzed, Determination made (fraud/not fraud/inconclusive)
Customer refunded (if applicable), Prevention actions implemented, Police report filed (if applicable), Case documented, Manager approval obtained

raw_entities.name: Evidence Gathering and Analysis
raw_entities.description: Initial step in case closure where all available evidence related to the disputed transaction is collected and thoroughly analyzed to support the fraud determination.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Determination
raw_entities.description: Critical decision step where investigators conclude whether the transaction is confirmed fraud, not fraud, or inconclusive based on the evidence analysis.

raw_entities.name: Customer Refund Issuance
raw_entities.description: Step where the disputed transaction amount is refunded to the customer's account when fraud is confirmed. Refund processing includes notification of the refund date and expected clearing time.
context: Refund of £[amount] issued to your account on [date]
Please allow 1–2 business days for the refund to appear

raw_entities.name: Fraud Prevention Actions Implementation
raw_entities.description: Step where protective measures are implemented to prevent future fraud on the customer's account, including card cancellation, password reset, and security feature enablement.
context: Issued new card (old one cancelled), Reset your online banking password, Enabled extra security features

raw_entities.name: Police Report Filing
raw_entities.description: Conditional step where a police report is filed when fraud is confirmed and circumstances warrant law enforcement involvement. A reference number is generated and provided to the customer.

raw_entities.name: Case Documentation
raw_entities.description: Step where all investigation findings, actions taken, and outcomes are formally recorded in the case file for audit and compliance purposes.

raw_entities.name: Manager Approval for Case Closure
raw_entities.description: Final authorization step where a manager reviews and approves the case closure, confirming that all investigation steps have been completed and documented appropriately.

raw_entities.name: Closure Notification to Customer
raw_entities.description: Step where the customer receives formal written notification of the investigation outcome, refund details, prevention actions taken, and guidance on further protective steps they should consider.
context: We have completed our investigation into the disputed transaction

raw_entities.name: Fraud Investigation Manager
raw_entities.description: Senior role responsible for approving case closure decisions and ensuring all investigation procedures have been properly completed and documented.

raw_entities.name: Financial Crime Team
raw_entities.description: Operational team responsible for conducting fraud investigations, gathering evidence, making fraud determinations, implementing prevention measures, and communicating outcomes to customers.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Investigation Analyst
raw_entities.description: Operational staff member who gathers and analyzes evidence, makes preliminary fraud determinations, and implements prevention actions during the investigation process.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Determination Gate
raw_entities.description: Critical branching point where the investigation outcome is classified as confirmed fraud, not fraud, or inconclusive. Each determination path triggers different notification and remediation actions.

raw_entities.name: Refund Eligibility Check
raw_entities.description: Decision point determining whether a customer refund is applicable based on the fraud determination outcome. Refunds are issued when fraud is confirmed.

raw_entities.name: Police Report Requirement Check
raw_entities.description: Conditional decision point determining whether circumstances warrant filing a police report. Police reporting is triggered when fraud is confirmed and severity or circumstances justify law enforcement involvement.

raw_entities.name: Disputed Transaction Fraud Investigation
raw_entities.description: Fraud investigation case triggered by a customer's dispute of a transaction. The investigation determines whether the transaction was unauthorized fraud, authorized, or inconclusive, and implements appropriate remediation.
context: We have completed our investigation into the disputed transaction

raw_entities.name: Fraud Dispute Customer
raw_entities.description: Individual customer who has disputed a transaction on their account and is the subject of the fraud investigation and closure process. Receives investigation outcome notification and refund if applicable.
context: We have completed our investigation into the disputed transaction

raw_entities.name: Disputed Transaction
raw_entities.description: Financial transaction on the customer's account that has been disputed as unauthorized. The transaction amount and date are documented in the investigation and closure notification.
context: We have completed our investigation into the disputed transaction of £[amount] on [date]

raw_entities.name: Debit Card
raw_entities.description: Payment card associated with the customer's account that was used for the disputed fraudulent transaction. The card is cancelled and replaced as part of fraud prevention measures.

raw_entities.name: Replacement Card
raw_entities.description: New debit card issued to the customer to replace the compromised card used in the fraudulent transaction.

raw_entities.name: Customer Account
raw_entities.description: Customer's bank account on which the disputed fraudulent transaction occurred and to which the refund is issued following investigation closure.
context: Refund of £[amount] issued to your account on [date]
